set CreateRollback = 1 set tTime = $Replace($ZDATETIME($H, 3), " ", "_") SET RollbackFilename = ..DeployLogDirectory_"Deployment_" _ compNm _ "_" _ type _ "_ROLLBACK_"_tTime Do ##class(%File).Delete(RollbackFilename)
SET WhereToLog = "L" SET LogFile = ..DeployLogDirectory_"Deployment_" _ compNm _ "_" _ type _ "_LOG_"_tTime Do ##class(%File).Delete(LogFile)
Set tSC = ##class(Ens.Deployment.Deploy).DeployCode(DeploymentFile,tProductionName,CreateRollback,RollbackFilename,WhereToLog,LogFile) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(usrNm, "Deploy status: " _ $case(tSC, 1:" OK",:"Error") ) Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(usrNm, "For details, view " _ LogFile) Quit tSC

Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status = $$$OK set ..DeployDirectory = $$$USRRELEASEBASEDIR _ usrNm _ $$$SVNSRCTRUNK
NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = nmSp Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(usrNm, "NAMESPACE: " _ $NAMESPACE) set tProductionName = ##class(Ens.Director).GetActiveProductionName()
if tProductionName = "" { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(usrNm, "Could not get active production in " _ $NAMESPACE) Quit $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, "Active production not found") } Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(usrNm, "Active PROD: " _ tProductionName)
if env = "" { Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm(usrNm, "Specify the environment") Quit $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, "The environment is required to pull the file information from the Database") } Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).DoSvnSetup(usrNm, passwd) Set tExportClsFilename = ..DeployDirectory_"Deployment_CLS_"_tItemName_".xml" set tSC = ..CheckoutFile(tExportClsFilename, usrNm, passwd, rev ) set tSC = ..CheckClassFiles(tItemName, tExportClsFilename, nmSp, usrNm, passwd, env )
Quit tSC
